```{r setup_suppE, echo = FALSE, warning=F, comment=F}

dev_mode = T
if(dev_mode){
  knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
  
  suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(sf)
    library(terra)
    library(geodata)
    library(rpostgis)
    library(tidyr)
    library(plyr) #ssurgo and climate data
    library(data.table) #fread function
    library(dataRetrieval) # USGS flow data
    library(lubridate)
    library(httr)
    library(stringr)
    library(rstudioapi)
    library(dataRetrieval) # for usgs data
    library(data.table) #month function
    library(zoo) # rolling means
    library(rgl) # plot3d
    library(MARSS)
    #spatial data libraries
    library(RANN)
    library(tmap)
    library(RColorBrewer)
    library(flextable)
    library(scales) # for alpha() color function
    library(ggthemes) # for colorblind_pal()
    library(colorspace) # for sequential_hcl()
    library(ggpubr) # to use get_palette()
    library(here)
  }
  )
  ms_dir = here::here()
  data_dir = file.path(here::here(), "Data")
  fig_dir = file.path(ms_dir, "Graphics and Supplements")
  load(file.path(ms_dir, "manuscript_data.RData")) # Load data layers/tables
  
  source(file.path(ms_dir,"02_Figure_Functions.R"))   # Load figure functions
  # print figures for slides, yes or no?
  save_figs_here = fig_dir#"C:/Users/Claire/Dropbox/Documents/UCD/Presentations_Talks_Workshops_miniprojects/2022.02.17 Peer Group presentation Ch. 1/figs"
  print_for_slides=T; fig_i = 50
  save_landuse_figure = F
  
}
```

# Scenario Design

```{r MARFieldsMap, echo = F, fig.cap="\\label{fig:MARFieldsMap} Fields used in the 2024 MAR recharge pilot program. These fields were used to specify areas where winter recharge (Jan-March) was applied each year in the Enhanced Recharge scenario." , warning=F}

fig_path = file.path(save_figs_here, paste0("Figure ",fig_i,".png"))
if(print_for_slides==T){
  png(filename = fig_path, width = 6, height = 7.5, units = "in", res = 300)

  
  plot(basin$geometry, main = "Scott Valley MAR Recharge Areas for \n Enhanced Recharge Scenario")
  plot(svihm_fields$geometry, add=T, col = "gray", border = "gray40")
  plot(mar_sp$geometry, add=T, col = "firebrick3", border = "gray40")
  plot(riv$geometry, add=T, col = "blue3", lwd=2)
  dev.off()
}

knitr::include_graphics(fig_path)
fig_i = fig_i + 1

```


```{r FJFlow, echo = F, fig.cap="\\label{fig:fjflow} Example scenario impacts on river flow: simulated FJ daily average flow (the basis for functional flows, which is the basis for HB function values) for multiple scenarios." , warning=F}

# Plot prep
plot_scenarios1 = c("basecase",  # "maxMAR_fields2024", "grain_12k",# "natveg_low_8k",
                    "alf_curtail_08.15","alf_curtail_07.31","alf_curtail_07.15")
scen_cols = get_palette(c("black","goldenrod","green4","dodgerblue3"),k=4)

fig_path = file.path(save_figs_here, paste0("Figure ",fig_i,".png"))
if(print_for_slides==T){
  png(filename=fig_path,width=7,height=5,unit="in",res=300)
  
  fj_flow_scen_plot( plot_scenarios1 = plot_scenarios1,
                     scen_cols = scen_cols)  

dev.off()
}
knitr::include_graphics(fig_path)
fig_i = fig_i + 1

```
